messages.subject: categorical variables in SEM
parts:
Hi!

I am making a SEM model in Lavaan and using a categorical variable. I read in the Lavaan tutorial that this is not (yet) possible. Does anyone know if this is coming in the near future?

Thanks in advance.

Dunja

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: categorical variables in SEM
parts: I am making a SEM model in Lavaan and using a categorical variable. I read in the Lavaan tutorial that this is not (yet) possible.

This has been available for years in single-level models.  

https://lavaan.ugent.be/features.html

But it still cannot fit multilevel SEM to categorical outcomes

https://lavaan.ugent.be/development.html

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
